chapters.chapter_title: I Like Riding a Bike on Sunday

questions.text: Which day comes immediately after Monday?
questions.discussion: Tuesday is the next day after Monday.

questions.text: Which day comes immediately before Thursday?
questions.discussion: Wednesday is one day earlier than Thursday.

questions.text: Sunday is the last day on Nisa’s chart. Which day follows Sunday when the week starts again?
questions.discussion: The cycle continues from Sunday to Monday.

questions.text: Fill the gap: Tuesday, Wednesday, ___, Friday.
questions.discussion: Thursday comes between Wednesday and Friday.

questions.text: Today is Saturday. What day was yesterday?
questions.discussion: Yesterday means one day before today.

questions.text: Today is Tuesday. What day is tomorrow?
questions.discussion: Tomorrow means one day after today.

questions.text: Which pair is in the order “day, next day”?
questions.discussion: Saturday is one day after Friday.

questions.text: Choose the usual spelling for the day after Tuesday.
questions.discussion: The standard spelling is Wednesday.

questions.text: Which sentence tells the day of an activity?
options: I ride a bike on Saturday.
questions.answer: I ride a bike on Saturday.
questions.discussion: On Saturday says when the activity happens.

questions.text: Complete: “I like reading ___ Friday.”
questions.discussion: Use on with a named day.

questions.text: Which question asks about a friend’s hobby on Sunday?
options: What do you like doing on Sunday?
questions.answer: What do you like doing on Sunday?
questions.discussion: What do you like doing asks about the activity, and on Sunday specifies the day.

questions.text: “What do you like doing on Saturday?” Which reply names an activity for that day?
questions.discussion: The reply names drawing and keeps the day as Saturday.

questions.text: Which question can be answered “Yes, I do”?
options: Do you like swimming on Friday?
What do you do on Friday?
questions.answer: Do you like swimming on Friday?
questions.discussion: A question starting with Do you can take the short reply Yes, I do.

questions.text: Mia doesn’t enjoy singing on Monday. How does she answer “Do you like singing on Monday?”
questions.discussion: Mia is answering about herself, so she uses I.

questions.text: Ari says, “I like reading on Thursday.” Which report keeps the same meaning?
questions.discussion: Use likes for Ari and keep both the activity and day.

questions.text: Tia and Nia enjoy drawing on Friday. What can you say about both?
questions.discussion: They refers to two people and takes like.

questions.text: Which question correctly asks about Riko’s preference?
options: Does Riko likes cycling on Sunday?
Does Riko like cycling on Sunday?
Do Riko like cycling on Sunday?
Does Riko like cycling in Sunday?
questions.answer: Does Riko like cycling on Sunday?
questions.discussion: After Does, use like. Use on before Sunday.

questions.text: A note says “Sita: swimming on Tuesday, drawing on Friday.” What does Sita do on Friday?
questions.discussion: The note pairs Friday with drawing.

questions.text: Bayu reads on Monday and Wednesday. On which day does he read first in that sequence?
questions.discussion: Monday comes before Wednesday in the sequence given.

questions.text: Ana reads on Friday. Wati reads on Saturday. Who reads one day after Ana?
questions.discussion: Saturday follows Friday, so Wati reads one day later.

questions.text: Lina draws on Monday. Bimo draws on Tuesday. What is the same?
questions.discussion: Both draw, on different days.

questions.text: Dodi swims on Sunday. Tono rides a bike on Sunday. What is the same?
questions.discussion: Both activities take place on Sunday.

questions.text: “I like cycling on Tuesday and Thursday.” Which day is named second?
questions.discussion: Thursday is the second day named in the sentence.

questions.text: “Do you like reading on Wednesday?” “No, I like reading on Thursday.” Which day should be recorded for reading?
questions.discussion: The reply gives Thursday as the preferred day.

questions.text: Which note records both the hobby and the day?
questions.discussion: The entry contains a day and an activity.

questions.text: You know that Ema likes drawing. Her day is missing. What can you ask?
questions.discussion: When asks for the time or day.

questions.text: Riko’s schedule lists football on Monday. What can you conclude?
options: Riko plays football only on Monday.
questions.discussion: The entry gives Monday and supplies no information about the other days.

questions.text: “Which day is right before Sunday?” Choose an answer.
questions.discussion: Saturday immediately precedes Sunday.

questions.text: Choose the correct order for the words: on / Tuesday / I / like / singing.
questions.discussion: Place the activity after like and the day after on.

questions.text: Which line correctly capitalizes the day name?
questions.discussion: English day names start with a capital letter.

questions.text: Rina is asked “Does Beni like riding a bike on Sunday?” Beni says Yes. How can Rina answer?
questions.discussion: He refers to Beni and does matches the question.

questions.text: Tia reads on the day immediately after Thursday. Which sentence fits?
questions.discussion: Friday is the day immediately after Thursday.

questions.text: A club moves its Saturday drawing session one day earlier. What is the new day?
questions.discussion: One day earlier than Saturday is Friday.

questions.text: A list says Monday — sing, Tuesday — draw, Wednesday — read. Which activity is between singing and reading?
questions.discussion: Tuesday’s drawing session falls between Monday and Wednesday.

questions.text: Nara says, “I swim on Friday, but I like reading on Saturday.” Which question does the second part answer?
options: What do you like doing on Saturday?
questions.answer: What do you like doing on Saturday?
questions.discussion: The second part tells what Nara likes doing on Saturday.
